motivation_from_prior_source_audit.conclusion: fine pitch type carries goal-scale information, but ordinary multiclass log-loss spends capacity on distinctions that do not preserve pitcher-specific control difficulty

hypothesis: A selector trained directly on the leave-one-out historical control propensity of the actually selected fine pitch can preserve control-relevant pitch-choice information better than an eight-class probability model.

source_protocol.history: R rows with season strictly less than source year
source_protocol.fine_label: normalized historical tagged_pitch_type from official TrackMan linkage

teacher.target: leave-one-out smoothed cell centered-control rate minus leave-one-out frozen repertoire expectation

selection_rule: maximize minimum exact-C full-score gain across 2020 and 2021, then minimum R gain; one common student variant and scale
next_step_if_pass: preregister the fixed variant and scale for 2022/2023 development
next_step_if_fail: close predictable current-pitch-selection axis without opening 2022+
